messages:
alex: finally set up my balcony office today. Problem: gusts make my mic pick up wind 32a3 anyone got cheap windscreen tips? (image attached)
sam: put a sock over the mic? laptop mics are so sensitive though.
lia: foam windscreen or a small deadcat for shotgun mics. for laptop mics, try moving mic behind a pillow or use noise suppression in meetings.
michael: Krisp or RNNoise in OBS are great. Zoom also has background noise suppression now.
owen: I use a pop filter from amazon on a USB mic, then a cheap windsock for outdoors.
nick: (image: balcony-setup.jpg) angle your mic away from the breeze and make a DIY windscreen from foam + pantyhose. taught me well at a weekend market.
alex: thanks! trying pantyhose + foam now 60a will report back.
lia: also, pro tip: put a heavy book under laptop feet so it doesn't get knocked over by gusts.
alex: update: pantyhose trick reduced wind noise by ~60%. conference call hero. (gif: mini-celebrate)
